objective: Aislar la causa exacta de R91B para 130MID 2026-09-11. Confirmar flags de Runtime y revisar anomalías de folio/encabezado-detalle que puedan bloquear el extractor. Solo lectura.

queries.name: runtime_flags_130mid_20260911_12
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha,ventas_total,tickets_total,pax_total,ventas_abiertas,es_venta_abierta,es_corte_cerrado,fuente_original FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) IN ('2026-09-11','2026-09-12') ORDER BY fecha

queries.name: duplicate_folios_130mid_20260911
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio,COUNT(*) AS rows_folio,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_sum,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS venta_max,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_sum,MAX(CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_max FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE CAST(tr.apertura AS date)='2026-09-11' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0 GROUP BY ch.folio HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY ch.folio

queries.name: ticket_header_detail_130mid_20260911
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT ch.folio,CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS header_total,CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentoycortesia,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS descuento_indicador FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE CAST(tr.apertura AS date)='2026-09-11' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0), d AS (SELECT dc.foliodet AS folio,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS detalle_total FROM cheqdet dc GROUP BY dc.foliodet) SELECT h.folio,h.header_total,ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS detalle_total,CAST(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,h.descuento_indicador FROM h LEFT JOIN d ON d.folio=h.folio WHERE ABS(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0))>0.05 ORDER BY ABS(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0)) DESC,h.folio
